id: title:haacked:keep person targeting when a set repeats a group property

review.posthog_relevance: Preservation of group-aggregated property metadata in the frontend feature-flag filter, preventing potential loss of stored aggregation indices when incoming conditions omit them.
review.reason: Adds a typed Map and its use to preserve group-aggregated property metadata when an incoming condition omits the stored aggregation index. This is a localized maintenance and correctness improvement.
review.uncertainty: The actual runtime benefit and whether this metadata loss could cause a production incident are not demonstrated; this is a defensive implementation without observed failure or adoption data.

observations.limitations: This chunk is a single, cohesive change group. No unrelated PRs are present. No score is assigned; tier assignment requires a score, not an observation. No score is assigned.

observations.behavior: Adds a typed Map and its use to preserve group-aggregated property metadata when an incoming condition omits the stored aggregation index.
observations.code_quote: const storedAggregations = new Set(aggregations.filter((aggregation) => aggregation !== undefined))
observations.posthog_connection: This preserves group-targeting metadata in the MCP agent's feature-flag filter, preventing loss of group aggregation when an incoming condition omits the stored aggregation index.
